capabilities: Generate folders and notes from an indented outline or name list
Apply per-folder templates and placeholder replacement
Create folder index notes with separate content settings
Save and load structure presets as Markdown notes
Report conflicts and skipped paths in a summary notice
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. Overwriting an existing note cannot be undone. Manual install or BRAT (Gowntn/obsidian-folder-forge). MIT license.
intentEvidence: The first version was based on the "auto generate folders" plugin by the Bilibili creator 拈花赛博行; this version is a rewrite and extension of that idea.
problem: Creating many folders and notes by hand in the file explorer is slow, and Obsidian has no built-in way to generate a whole structure from a text outline.

relations.evidence: The first version was based on the "auto generate folders" plugin by the Bilibili creator 拈花赛博行; this version is a rewrite and extension of that idea.

summary: Batch folder and note generator that builds folder trees and Markdown notes from an indented outline or a name list.
